hooks.name: Translate missing locale keys when en.json changes
hooks.description: After en.json is saved, list missing core-locale keys and translate them for real

action.prompt: en.json was saved. Run `node scripts/hooks/locale-sync.cjs`. For every key it lists, write a real translation into that core locale file (ms, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ta, es), matching the tone of the existing strings. Never copy the English text and never add "[MT]" placeholders. Run the script again until it reports every core locale complete.
